tools.name: get_call
tools.description: Current signed call for one market and style: action (long/short/flat), entry reference price, stop loss, take profit, leverage hint, confidence, regime, and whether it is still actionable. Also returns the live score.

tools.name: get_ledger
tools.description: Past calls, newest first, each with its outcome (tp, sl, superseded, expired) and return. Filter by symbol, style and signal. Paginate with before_seq.

tools.name: get_track_record
tools.description: Win rate, average and total return of resolved calls (up to the last 1000) for a symbol/style/signal filter. Live results, not backtests.

tools.name: verify_call
tools.description: Check one call's integrity: body hash, id, ed25519 signature, and its link to the previous ledger entry.

tools.name: list_signals
tools.description: Published community signals with backtest metrics and live trading stats. Use a returned id as signal_id in get_call.

tools.name: get_signal
tools.description: Definition, backtest metrics and live stats for one published sig_... signal.
